verdict.rationale: Carta's API exposes cap table, stakeholder, option grant, convertible note, and FMV data programmatically (carta-docs-18–23) and its data warehouse supports SQL export/queries (carta-docs-17, carta-docs-29), suggesting technical export capability exists. However, this is not the same as an easy self-serve Excel/CSV export — no docs mention a native CSV/Excel export button, and a competitor (Eqvista) and multiple founders report that Carta makes cap table data specifically hard to transfer out and cancellation practically impossible without lengthy rep interactions (carta-comm-5, carta-comm-7), directly contradicting the 'never held hostage' claim. Missing for 10: explicit self-serve CSV/Excel export documentation, independent confirmation that full transaction history (not just current cap table) can be exported, and evidence refuting the migration-friction complaints.
